    The proper-component subspace of a string endomorphism ring #

    The graph-component basis splits into the diagonal identity component and the remaining proper self-overlap components. This file packages the span of the proper components and identifies it with the kernel of the diagonal basis coordinate. Closure under multiplication and nilpotence remain separate combinatorial obligations.
